skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the nature and role of public finance, and analyze public finance policies based on four criteria: economy, efficiency, effectiveness, and equity.
Analyze and evaluate public policies, including taxation, public expenditure, and public debt management.
Understand and analyze the impact of taxation on income distribution and economic efficiency.
Evaluate public sector management practices and reforms, including budget management and fiscal decentralization.
Develop critical thinking skills to analyze and evaluate public policies and reforms.
Improve communication skills through reading, writing, presenting, and debating on public finance topics.
Conduct research and write reports on public finance topics, including data analysis and referencing credible sources.
Understand ethical and professional responsibilities in public finance and contribute to the effective and fair use of public resources.
Work effectively in teams, organize, supervise, and inspire team members in completing tasks and social activities.
Develop self-learning and research skills to accumulate knowledge and stay updated on public finance developments.
